issues.description: Owner agent-e: Rewrite to the mandatory brief output contract; this summary has 3 quantitative result objects (maximum 2) and 8 beginner concepts (allowed 3–5).

Owner agent-e: Numeric statements outside claim/result objects, including evaluation.setting and other free-text fields, lack source IDs and page/section/figure/table locators. Audit every number and move each retained value into a sourced claim/result or remove it.

Owner agent-b: Remove high-performance-computing and measurement-study. OrchFS contributes a heterogeneous NVM/SSD file-system design; parallel I/O implementation and evaluation do not make it an HPC measurement study.
Owner agent-e: Correct claim-orchfs-paths: Figure 6 is on physical PDF page 6, not pages 9–10. Retain the §3.6 prose locator separately if it supports the remaining statement.

Owner agent-f: Replace or repair the two stored HUST faculty evidence URLs. Both HTTPS endpoints timed out in independent browser and HTTP-client checks; only their HTTP variants were reachable, so the recorded links are not currently verifiable.

notes: Reopened the official USENIX paper page and PDF; checked metadata, relevance, mechanism, assumptions, evaluation, baselines, every numeric claim and locator, and limitations.
Checked official group/faculty evidence, FAST 2025 awards, repository-wide duplicate titles, and stored link targets.
Open ERROR findings are routed to the owning stage agent; source-stage files were not modified.
